verified: Teslarati, citing Tesla’s November 16 announcement and a new service map, reports that the Miami geofence grew to about 59 square miles from roughly 31, and that Downtown, Brickell, Wynwood, Little Havana and Hialeah are now inside it; Tesla began unsupervised Miami rides on July 3 and has run 24-hour service since mid-November.
unconfirmed: The article contradicts itself on Miami Beach—first listing it among newly included areas, then saying it remains outside—and the 59-square-mile figure and exact boundary come from Teslarati’s reading of Tesla’s map, not an independent measurement. The sources do not include independent data on ride volume or service quality.

verified: 据 Teslarati 报道，特斯拉 11 月 16 日宣布扩大迈阿密服务区，新地图覆盖市中心、Brickell、Wynwood、小哈瓦那、比斯坎湾滨水区与 Hialeah；该市场自 7 月 3 日上线，初期围栏约 25 平方英里、后小幅扩至约 31 平方英里，车辆为通过 Tesla Robotaxi 应用呼叫的 Model Y，11 月中起 24 小时运营。
unconfirmed: 约 59 平方英里与“92% 增幅”是媒体按地图推算，并非特斯拉公布的数字；特斯拉未披露车队规模、订单量或安全数据。迈阿密海滩是否已纳入，原文一处称“现已包含”，后文又称“仍在服务区之外”，且以 Waymo 范围“已含海滩”作对比，暗示特斯拉尚未覆盖，此点需以特斯拉官方地图为准。

titles.en: Tesla expands Miami Robotaxi geofence to about 59 square miles
